integrity: The optimum value \(P(5,6)=5\) is prior work. The new claim is the complete labeled extremizer census, equidistance, the two-orbit decomposition under the stated action, and the cyclic-subgroup/coset structure. The bundled verifier reconstructs these facts from definitions.
scientific_limitations: The classification is finite and specific to \(S_5\) at minimum Kendall-tau distance \(6\). The stated 240-element action is an explicit isometry subgroup; no claim is made that it is the full isometry group. An obscure or unindexed prior finite census remains a residual originality risk.
title: Complete extremizer classification for Kendall-tau codes in the five-symbol symmetric group at distance six
